name: SMTP2GO
summary: SMTP2GO is a delivery service with an HTTP API and an SMTP relay. The free plan covers 1,000 emails a month, Starter costs $10 a month for 10,000 emails, and Professional costs $75 for 100,000 and includes a dedicated IP. Email reporting is kept 30 days on paid plans.

facts.text: The API sends a standard email with a POST to api.smtp2go.com/v3/email/send.
The API exposes email search at /email/search, account activity search at /activity/search, and bounce and spam statistics.
Suppression lists can be viewed, added to and cleared through the endpoints /suppression/view, /suppression/add and /suppression/remove.
Webhook email events are Processed, Delivered, Open, Click, Bounce, Spam, Unsubscribe, Resubscribe and Reject.
SMTP2GO states it is ISO 27001 and ISO 9001 certified and GDPR compliant, and says its US and EU data centers carry SOC 2 Type 2 attestations.

plans.name: Free
plans.notes: Live chat and phone support limited to 14 days

plans.name: Starter
plans.notes: Extra emails $1 per 1,000. $100 a year on annual billing

plans.name: Professional
plans.notes: Extra emails $0.85 per 1,000. $750 a year on annual billing. Dedicated IP included

hiddenCosts: The pricing page shows a Premier plan for over 3,000,000 emails with prices that match Professional, so ask sales for a real quote.
A sign-up window on the same page shows $79 a month and $948 a year without naming a plan.

contract.cancellation: The terms say the customer can cancel at any time and stays liable for charges to that point. SMTP2GO may end access at any time without notice or refund. Full refunds are granted for requests within the first 30 days.
contract.dataExport: SMTP2GO may delete the program and data files tied to a closed account, with no retention period stated.
